# agenthicc

> A state-driven Python agent runtime for software engineering: event-sourced
> kernel, configurable workflows, capability-gated tools, durable sessions,
> and a Rich Live terminal workspace.

## Current runtime

The primary entry point is `agenthicc.__main__:main`.

- `agenthicc` launches the Rich workspace and interactive `TUISession`.
- `agenthicc --mode MODE --workflow NAME` starts the TUI with explicit mode and
  workflow selections; `--workflow NAME` also selects the headless stdin workflow.
- `agenthicc --headless` reads non-empty stdin lines and emits JSON-lines.
- `agenthicc --headless --workflow NAME` executes NAME for each stdin line.
- `kernel.AppState` is frozen domain state reduced from `Event` objects.
- `tui.conversation_store.AppState` is a separate reactive presentation model.
- `workflows/` contains `WorkflowPlugin`, phase specs, generic runners, and the
  built-in code-plan workflow.
- `agents/`, `modes/`, `skills/`, `commands/`, and project plugin loaders provide
  extension points.
- `tools/` provides class-based tools, filesystem/git/exec integrations, MCP,
  capability metadata, approvals, path and network guards, shared HTTP safety
  helpers, and an optional CloakBrowser adapter.
- `tui.runtime.mode_manager` is the canonical mode registry: selectable modes
  cycle `Safe → Plan → Yolo`; `Auto`, `Guard`, `Ask`, and `Review` are
  non-displayed compatibility aliases, and `Replay` is internal-only.
- `memory/` provides session/project/global tiers, semantic search, compaction,
  conversation journaling, and durable idempotent tool replay support.
- `session_service/` provides client-neutral snapshots, typed commands,
  versioned durable events, replay, bounded subscriptions, and an explicit
  loopback HTTP/SSE adapter shared by TUI, headless, CLI, web, and IDE clients.
- `agenthicc init` creates an empty `AGENTS.md`, `.agenthicc/`, and a fully
  commented project configuration template; `/init` remains the managed
  `AGENTS.md` guidance preview/write command.
- Skills use validated `SKILL.md` frontmatter, canonical names, compatibility
  aliases, discovery diagnostics, per-agent allow/deny policies, and live
  `/skills reload` refresh in the interactive TUI.

## Important symbols

| Symbol | Module | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `AppState` | `agenthicc.kernel` | Frozen kernel domain state |
| `Event` | `agenthicc.kernel` | Serialized domain event |
| `EventProcessor` | `agenthicc.kernel` | MPSC queue and reducer loop |
| `root_reducer` | `agenthicc.kernel` | Pure event-to-state reducer |
| `load_config` | `agenthicc.config` | TOML/env/CLI configuration loader |
| `ProviderProfile` / `SecretReference` / `RequestOptionSettings` | `agenthicc.config` | Typed provider profiles, environment-backed secrets, and request options |
| `ResolvedProviderProfile` | `agenthicc.config` | Runtime profile with secrets resolved at session startup |
| `PermissionChecker` | `agenthicc.security` | Ordered fail-closed policy evaluator |
| `MemoryRouter` | `agenthicc.memory` | Three-tier memory dispatcher |
| `Tool` / `ToolBase` | `agenthicc.tools` | Legacy and typed class-based contracts adapted to lauren-ai |
| `ToolLike` / `arg_*` helpers | `agenthicc.tools` | Typed callable compatibility and runtime argument narrowing |
| `JsonScalar` / `JsonValue` / `JsonObject` | `agenthicc.types` | Recursive JSON vocabulary for open boundary data |
| `ToolExecutor` | `agenthicc.tools` | lauren-ai-backed callable/class tool dispatcher |
| `ToolResult` / `ToolResultEnvelope` | `agenthicc.tools` | Typed compatibility and adapter result envelopes |
| `TerminalManager` / `TerminalStore` | `agenthicc.background.terminals` | Owned process groups, bounded output, handles, wait, stop, and local recovery |
| `TerminalState` / `TerminalRecord` | `agenthicc.background.terminals` | Durable background-terminal lifecycle and redacted result metadata |
| `CommandOutcome` / `CommandState` / `CommandKind` | `agenthicc.tools.exec` | Canonical command states, deadlines, cancellation, and service lifecycle |
| `ToolSandbox` / `WorkspaceView` | `agenthicc.tools` | Timeout, resource, network, and real-path boundaries |
| `WorkspaceScope` / `WorkspaceAccessPolicy` | `agenthicc.tools.workspace_access` | Session-wide canonical roots and Safe/Plan/Yolo path authorization |
| `ToolMetadata` / `ToolErrorKind` | `agenthicc.tools` | Generated catalog metadata and stable error taxonomy |
| `SearchWebTool` / `FetchPageTool` | `agenthicc.skills.web_search` | Native lauren-ai tools for Brave search and visible page-text extraction |
| `WorkflowPlugin` | `agenthicc.workflows` | Custom workflow definition |
| `PhaseSpec` | `agenthicc.workflows.plugin` | Declarative phase metadata; `system_prompt_override` replaces the role prompt only in the generic runner and remains dynamic under the cache contract |
| `SessionConversation` / `WorkflowRunHandle` | `agenthicc.runners` | Session-wide provider memory and resumable workflow ownership |
| `StartupCoordinator` / `StartupPhaseReport` / `ReadinessState` | `agenthicc.runners.startup` | Session-scoped progressive startup phases, readiness gates, cancellation, and redacted diagnostics |
| `JournaledShortTermMemory` / `ConversationJournal` | `agenthicc.memory` | Durable provider memory, transactional tool-exchange recovery, and complete subagent-result persistence |
| `WorkflowCheckpoint` / `WorkflowCheckpointStore` | `agenthicc.workflows.checkpoint` / `agenthicc.runners` | Versioned workflow context checkpoints, structured error pauses, and diagnostic fallback records |
| `WorkflowFailureKind` | `agenthicc.runners.workflow_handle` | Typed stable categories for workflow failure finalization and diagnostics |
| `WorkflowRecoveryCoordinator` / `WorkflowRecoveryRecord` | `agenthicc.runners.workflow_recovery` | Fail-closed interrupted/error-paused discovery, validation, claims, and typed rehydration |
| `PromptContract` / `build_workflow_prompt_contract` | `agenthicc.runners.prompt_contract` | Cache-stable system/tool prefix plus append-only dynamic workflow context; emits redacted cache diagnostics |
| `WorkflowExecutionResult` | `agenthicc.runners.headless` | JSON-safe headless workflow outcome |
| `DEFAULT_SUBAGENT_TIMEOUT_S` / `SubagentTypeSpec` / `SubagentPool` | `agenthicc.subagents` | Typed concurrent workers with complete-output aggregation; `spawn_subagents(timeout_s=...)` defaults to one hour |
| `execute_workflow` | `agenthicc.runners.headless` | Execute a registered workflow in a session |
| `run_headless_workflow` | `agenthicc.runners.headless` | Build, run, and close one headless workflow session |
| `Workspace` | `agenthicc.tui.workspace` | Rich Live UI root |
| `UnifiedInputSession` | `agenthicc.tui.input` | Lifetime input/raw-mode loop |
| `ModeManager` / `ModeRegistry` / `RuntimeMode` | `agenthicc.tui.runtime` | Canonical Safe/Plan/Yolo selection, aliases, lifecycle state, and capability policy |
| `ToolCapability` / `classify_tool_capabilities` | `agenthicc.tools.capabilities` | Capability taxonomy and fail-closed metadata classification |
| `tool_exploratory` / `is_exploratory_tool` | `agenthicc.tools.capabilities` | Presentation-only marker and safe classification for derived TUI grouping |
| `CloakBrowserSettings` / `PlaywrightSettings` | `agenthicc.config` | Optional browser backend configuration; liberal all-address defaults with explicit restrictive opt-in |
| `BrowserSessionManager` / `BrowserPolicy` | `agenthicc.tools.cloakbrowser` | Shared session-scoped browser lifecycle, allow-list, quotas, artifacts, and checkpoint metadata |
| `make_cloakbrowser_tools` / `make_playwright_tools` | `agenthicc.tools.cloakbrowser` / `agenthicc.tools.playwright` | Nine capability-tagged agent-facing tools for either lazy optional backend |
| `export_session` | `agenthicc.tui.runtime.session_export` | Redacted portable session export |
| `inspect_session` | `agenthicc.tui.runtime.session_export` | Redacted durable session health and usage summary |
| `SessionService` / `SessionSnapshot` / `SessionCommand` | `agenthicc.session_service` | Client-neutral session coordination and policy-filtered read model |
| `SessionEvent` / `SessionEventStore` | `agenthicc.session_service` | Versioned durable event envelope and fsync-backed replay ledger |
| `UsageLedger` / `UsageRecord` / `UsageSnapshot` | `agenthicc.runners.usage_ledger` | Session-scoped durable provider usage, quality, cost, and reconciliation |
| `InProcessSessionClient` / `HttpSessionClient` | `agenthicc.session_service` | In-process and local HTTP client adapters |
| `WebSessionAdapter` / `IdeSessionAdapter` | `agenthicc.session_service` | Transport adapters for future web and IDE/ACP clients |
| `ProjectSnapshot` / `ProjectBootstrapPlan` / `ProjectInitResult` | `agenthicc.project_bootstrap` | Bounded inspection, guidance proposals, and safe project scaffold result |
| `build_bootstrap_plan` / `inspect_project` / `initialize_project` / `write_bootstrap_plan` | `agenthicc.project_bootstrap` | Safe project-guidance and configuration bootstrap lifecycle |

| `SkillDef` / `SkillDiscoveryResult` | `agenthicc.skills.loader` | Validated skill metadata and diagnostic discovery result |
| `discover_skills_with_diagnostics` / `filter_skills_for_agent` | `agenthicc.skills.loader` | Skill discovery diagnostics and per-agent permission filtering |

## Configuration

```toml
[execution]
provider = "anthropic"
model = "" # provider default when empty
max_parallel_tasks = 4
auto_compact = true

[memory]
project_memory_path = ".agenthicc/memory"

[security]
sandbox_mode = true
allowed_paths = ["/absolute/path/to/project"]
network_allow_list = []
```

Provider keys are `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, or no key for Ollama.
See `docs/guides/configuration.md` for precedence and the full settings model.

## Concurrent subagents

`spawn_subagents` is injected into the normal parent turn when the active
workflow phase allows it. It accepts task objects with required `type` and
`task` strings plus optional `context`, runs isolated typed workers under a
`max_concurrent` semaphore, and returns one complete labelled text digest.
Workers receive the parent tool ceiling and capability/approval/workspace
policy; they do not share parent message memory and cannot spawn recursively.
Empty provider finals receive one bounded finalisation turn. Complete worker
and pool results are fsync'd to the session conversation journal; only
TUI/kernel previews are bounded. Complete aggregates can be reused on resume
using an order-insensitive key containing role, task, and context. See
`docs/guides/subagents.md` for the source-level lifecycle, result contract,
and failure semantics.

## Persistence

Session artifacts are under `~/.agenthicc/sessions/`: kernel JSONL, conversation
JSONL, and an fsync-backed conversation journal. Project memory/cache/trust
data lives under `.agenthicc/`; global memory defaults to
`~/.agenthicc/global.db`.
Owned terminal records are stored under `~/.agenthicc/background/terminals/`
and remain separate from durable agent-session records.

Durable session attachment is single-owner. `--continue`, `--resume`, the
session picker, headless workflow execution, and explicit background attaches
claim `<session-id>/.owner` before restoring journals or constructing providers,
tools, or workflows. A live conflict is the typed `session_already_active`
diagnostic with exit status 3; stale records are reclaimed only after local
process death is proven. Workflow `<run-id>/.claim` remains a nested, separate
guard.

## Invariants

`create_workflow` is modelled on `code_plan`: typed phase state evolved by an
outer loop, one bounded async method per phase as the inner loop, transitions
only via tool calls, and a typed context capturing each phase's artefact. Every
phase prompt receives a `[PHASE TRANSITION TOOLS]` block naming the available
handoff tools; only a successful call advances state, never assistant prose.
Custom handoff callables marked with `@tool_control` are discovered automatically.
The workflow's four phases are design (human-approved, read-only), generate (`Yolo` mode, writes
a run-owned draft under `.agenthicc/workflows/.drafts/<run-id>/<name>/`), validate
(deterministic import/check plus a bounded fake-provider smoke contract, then the agent's vote),
and summarize. Approved drafts are atomically published to
`.agenthicc/workflows/<name>/` only after all gates pass:

`code_plan` plan approval presents explicit `Approve - Safe` and
`Approve - YOLO` choices. The selected mode is carried into the execute phase
and restored from phase metadata on resume; missing or invalid selections use
the fail-closed `Safe` default. `create_workflow` design approval remains on
the legacy plan-review option set.

| CreateWorkflowState | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.state | Design/generate/validate/summarize state machine with COMPLETE, EXITED, FAILED terminals |
| CreateWorkflowContext | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.state | Typed intent, approved design, draft/publication evidence, per-phase `PhaseArtifact`s, shared memory, and checkpoint provenance |
| make_*_tools | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.phase_tools | Phase transition handoffs; rejected transitions return actionable `error`, `fix`, and `message` fields |
| validate_workflow_file | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.validation | Imports and statically checks the generated draft like the loader does; structured categories/evidence and a failing report override agent approval |
| make_inspection_tools | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.inspection_tools | Read-only authoring-surface inspection read live from `PhaseSpec`, `ToolCapability`, `PhaseRole`; with a snapshot, also exposes effective catalog/decision tools |
| build_authoring_snapshot | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.catalog | Bounded, redacted live tool/dependency/policy snapshot used by authoring turns and checkpoint provenance |
| scan_draft / publish_draft | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.draft | Exact manifest scanning and failure-safe atomic publication of a run-owned workflow draft |
| run_generated_workflow_smoke | agenthicc.workflows.create_workflow.smoke | Fake-provider, no-network contract smoke for generated custom runners |

A generated workflow is expected to ship its own state-machine runner in
`<name>/runner.py` (typed state enum, typed context, one bounded async method per state,
`while not state.is_terminal` + `match` driver, `resume()`, phase tool factories,
`build_runner()`). `CodePlanRunner.run_phase(..., tools=...)` is the public helper
for running one tool-gated phase. Validation warns when a multi-phase workflow
inherits the declarative runner.

Custom runners should pass a literal `stable_system_prompt` policy to
`run_phase`; phase state, artifacts, questions, answers, and summaries remain in
dynamic context. Generated workflows must use the existing `ask_user` tool for
material ambiguity and strict validation rejects direct history insertion or
turn calls that bypass the contract.

Every session also carries five read-only self-inspection tools so the agent reads
the current API instead of remembering it:

| list_agenthicc_docs / read_agenthicc_doc / search_agenthicc_docs | agenthicc.tools.introspect | The `docs/` tree plus `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `README.md`; bounded windows and capped searches |
| inspect_agenthicc_source / search_agenthicc_source | agenthicc.tools.introspect | Any `agenthicc` module or symbol, resolved by path + `ast` with no imports; private names included |

- Start `EventProcessor.run()` before `emit()` and await `drain()` before reading.
- `[execution].max_output_tokens` (default 32768) caps one LLM round-trip. It must
  exceed the largest single tool call: lauren-ai's 4096 default silently truncates
  a `write_file` carrying a whole file, discarding the tool call entirely.
- `root_reducer` is pure and kernel `AppState` is frozen.
- Use `WorkspaceView` for filesystem paths and the shared HTTP client for tools.
- Child capability scopes can only restrict their parent.
- Durable tool results must be replay-safe across a transport retry or resume.
- Tool-call histories are validated by lauren-ai before provider I/O. Each
  assistant call has exactly one result; cancellation/approval filtering records
  synthetic error results for unresolved calls, while unknown/duplicate/empty or
  non-adjacent IDs fail closed with a safe diagnostic. The shared lifecycle
  signals are `ToolExchangeStarted`, `ToolExchangeResultRecorded`,
  `ToolExchangeCommitted`, `ToolExchangeAborted`, and `ToolExchangeRepaired`.
- Direct turns and workflows in one session reuse one `conversation_id` and one
  journal-backed provider memory; custom runner contexts must provide paired
  checkpoint codecs (generated workflows are rejected without them), while
  legacy unsupported plugins fail closed on Esc.
- Generated plugins that use optional services declare
  `required_integrations`, `optional_integrations`, and
  `integration_fallbacks`; validation records redacted availability and rejects
  unavailable required services without a usable fallback.

The repository does not currently contain `agenthicc.api`, `tui.app`,
`tui.transcript`, or `tui.events`; those are historical or unresolved product
surfaces. `agenthicc.tools.hooks` and `agenthicc.tools.executor` do exist, but
they are compatibility adapters over lauren-ai's canonical hook and executor
contracts, not a separate lifecycle engine. The documented improvement plan is
`prds/prd-138-repository-improvement-roadmap.md`.
